identity.name: Markets by Kinetiq Alibaba ADR Perp

about.description: Single-stock perpetual market tracking the U.S.-listed Alibaba ADR. The contract gives synthetic exposure to Alibaba’s ADR price without ownership of depositary shares, shareholder rights, or dividend claims. Positions are margined and cash-settled in USDH. The market is visible on Hyperliquid under the km namespace, but it is operated by Markets by Kinetiq rather than listed as a core Hyperliquid perp.
